evidence.text: Phonosemantic compound. 目 represents the meaning and 垂 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *djols): semantic 目 (“eye”) + phonetic 垂 (OC *djol) – sleep.
May be from Proto-Sino-Tibetan *(d/n)waj (“to hang from; to cling to; creeper”); see 垂 (OC *djol, “to hang down”) for more (STEDT).

editorial_rules: Write about the character's graphic history; distinguish it from the history of a spoken word.

Unrelated word senses may appear in Wiktionary excerpts. Do not merge them into a character origin.
